actual_exposure.prior_assessment: Previously inspected development review summaries, evaluator/schema code, native metadata, historical agent review records, and truncated source/target snippets and derived inventories from the prepared reading bundle; disclosed to root before blind reviewer selection.
actual_exposure.reserved_data: Only reserved source metadata was available through the existing guarded native validator and prior source-metadata inspection; no reserved source bytes were opened.
actual_exposure.source_text_manual_review: This audit validates bytes and recorded judgments; it does not claim a fresh blind editorial reannotation or a manual complete rereading of all target prose.
actual_exposure.this_audit: Read both raw current reviews, selection, freeze, agreement/adjudication, accepted annotation manifests and report metadata. Programmatically read and hash all 13 actual supplied reading files and canonical bundle; existing validators read the selected source, two targets and offline Git proof; two detector report rebuilds exposed current predictions.

limitations: One natural source and one group provide two clean fragment-free local-file cases, no positive M012 issue, and no fragment-membership cases.
The two remote HTTPS destinations are resolver exclusions; neither remote validity nor live hosting behavior was judged.

Both agents saw supplied target-presence metadata and derived inventories. Their original exposure declarations are preserved; root was exposed and reconciled matching judgments rather than serving as a blind reviewer.

The all-rules report passes 2/2 clean negatives with 0 TP/FP/FN, 30 reviewed prose words, and unavailable precision/recall/span accuracy. Production has zero eligible coverage, 0/0 negatives, and unavailable rates.

Whole-source-group uncertainty is unavailable with one contributing density group and no precision/recall denominators. Descriptive agent agreement is not human reliability or population effectiveness.
No triggered diagnostic or revised text exists in this batch; usefulness and semantic meaning preservation are unavailable.

Commit contents and recorded report runtime verify the declared freeze dependency; historical first-read and first-prediction timing remains the operation/provenance record, not an independently observable clock proof.
Native validators reprove the supplied offline pinned Git objects and exact byte bindings. This audit did not fetch live upstream content or reconsider source reuse terms.
This acceptance does not cover later README/PLAN edits, wheel-smoke.json, full repository test gates or merge/release actions.
